generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short: Sample from a pool of realistic short strings; 10% near-variants (case change, trailing space, one-char edit) of an existing value; never exceed declared length.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_id: Sample from a pool of digit strings of length 5 (or 8 for course_id) with leading zeros allowed; ensure uniqueness within the table's key.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_name: Sample from a pool of surnames; 20% duplicate share; 5% near-variants (case change, one-char edit).
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_title: Sample from a pool of course-title-like phrases; 30% duplicate share; 5% near-variants.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_building: Sample from a pool of building names; 20% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_room: Sample from a pool of 3-digit room numbers; 20% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_semester: Sample from {'Fall','Spring','Summer','Winter'} exactly; no case variants (CHECK forbids).
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_grade: Sample from {'A+','A','A-','B+','B','B-','C+','C','C-','D','F'}; plant NULL on a subset for nullable handling.
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_int_small: Uniform integer in the column's CHECK range; include boundary values and one step on each side where a CHECK exists.
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_money: Uniform decimal with 2 fractional digits in the column's CHECK range; include boundary values.
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_credits: Sample from {3,4} for bulk rows; 10% of rows draw CHECK-boundary probes {1,2} (both satisfy credits > 0).
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_year: Bulk draws uniform integer in [2001,2010]; 15% of rows draw from boundary probes {1702,1703,2008,2009,2010,2011,2098,2099} (all satisfy 1701 < year < 2100).
generic_sampling_rules.composite_fk_null: For a composite foreign key whose columns are jointly nullable (section.building + section.room_number), plant NULL in all columns of the tuple together or none; never a partial NULL. The non-NULL branch draws a valid parent tuple.
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: The NULL rule applies only to the columns listed in null_targets (the spec's NULLABLE list); other nullable columns may remain NULL-free. For each listed column, each instance contains at least one NULL row and non-NULL rows; NULL share is computed on the final written row count (after dedup/filtering) and follows the compact database's share for that column (0.0 observed, so use 2-5% planted NULLs). NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL. Rules, lookups and formulas constrain only non-NULL operands (SQL three-valued logic).
generic_sampling_rules.fk_validation: All foreign keys are validated against the FINAL written parent rows (post-dedup, post-filter, post-NULL-planting, post-group-size-realization). Any row whose FK target is absent from the final written parent set is dropped or re-pointed to an existing parent value before writing. pragma foreign_keys is ON during write; a post-write integrity check must report fk_violations = 0.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_realization: Group-size targets are constructed explicitly on the final written set: for department.dept_name, child rows (course/instructor/student dept_name) are assigned so that at least one dept has exactly 1 child, one has exactly 2, and one has >=3, using only dept values present in department; for prereq.course_id, course_id values are assigned so that some course appears once, some twice, and some >=3 times, while keeping (course_id, prereq_id) unique and both FKs valid (prereq_id drawn only from existing course ids). Group-size realization never overwrites a planted NULL with a non-NULL value; if it would, the NULL is re-planted afterward. Verification runs on the final written rows and reports group_sizes_ok: true.
generic_sampling_rules.null_planting_order: NULL planting runs after all row-dropping (FK validation, dedup, formula filtering) and after group-size realization, or the share is recomputed on the post-write count and adjusted. Each listed null_target has >=1 NULL and a 2-5% share on the final written rows; NOT NULL/PK columns have zero NULLs.

per_column_exceptions.note: dept_name is PK; group sizes 1/2/>=3 must be realized across the final written set (compact + appended) via child tables (course/instructor/student dept_name), not by duplicating dept_name values. At least one dept with exactly 1 child, one with exactly 2, one with >=3, using only dept values present in department.
Targets 'fall','spring','g','G' from the atomic summary are unreachable under CHECK (semester IN ('Fall','Winter','Spring','Summer')) and are intentionally not generated.
2011 is included in CHECK_BOUNDARIES for section.year so it is generated at the 15% boundary rate; 2099 is a CHECK-boundary probe.

course_id is part of composite PK (course_id, prereq_id); group sizes must be realized across the final written set (compact + appended) by varying prereq_id, not by duplicating (course_id, prereq_id) tuples. Some course appears once, some twice, some >=3 times; prereq_id drawn only from existing course ids.

dependencies.note: PK uniqueness: generated PK tuples must be checked against the full composite PK set of compact rows, not just the first PK column.
PK uniqueness: appended department rows must not duplicate compact dept_name values; group-size targets are realized via child tables.
Composite PK uniqueness: appended prereq rows must not duplicate compact (course_id, prereq_id) tuples; group-size targets are realized by varying prereq_id among existing course ids.

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: end_hr > start_hr OR (end_hr = start_hr AND end_min > start_min)
semantic_rules_and_formulas.condition: start_hr IS NOT NULL AND start_min IS NOT NULL AND end_hr IS NOT NULL AND end_min IS NOT NULL
semantic_rules_and_formulas.evidence: Shown rows: start 8:00 end 8:50; start 9:30 end 11:30; start 11:00 end 13:45; start 13:30 end 15:30; start 10:00 end 12:30; start 14:00 end 16:45; start 16:00 end 16:50. Formula holds on every shown row; NULL operands pass under SQL three-valued logic.

supporting_evidence.section.semester: Shown semesters Fall, Spring; CHECK allows Fall/Winter/Spring/Summer.
supporting_evidence.time_slot: Shown start_hr 8-16, start_min 0/30, end_hr 8-16, end_min 30/45/50; end after start in every shown row.

uncertainty: No sample formula relates columns across tables (e.g., tot_cred vs takes). The year domain is ambiguous between the declared CHECK (1702-2099) and observed values (2001-2010); both domains are listed (observed-style draws plus CHECK-boundary probes including 2011). The semester case-variant boundary values ('fall', 'spring', 'g', 'G') from the atomic-operation summary are omitted because the CHECK constraint forbids them and would filter every plant; 'g' and 'G' are unreachable under the CHECK and are intentionally not generated. Composite-FK NULL handling for section.(building,room_number) must be co-nulled; partial-NULL tuples are invalid against classroom. Group-size targets on department.dept_name and prereq.course_id cannot be realized by duplicating PK values; they must be realized across the final written set (compact + appended) via child tables (course/instructor/student dept_name for department; varying prereq_id among existing course ids for prereq) and verified post-generation. The NULL rule applies only to the columns listed in null_targets; other nullable columns may remain NULL-free. The time_slot end-after-start formula holds under SQL three-valued logic when operands are NULL. table_sizes_per_instance describes the compact database's row counts (copied as-is); appended rows are governed by the program's EXTRA_ROWS caps. course.credits uses EnumSampler {3,4} for bulk rows with 10% CHECK-boundary probes {1,2}; the RANGES entry (1,4) is superseded by this rule. FK validation is performed against the final written parent rows (post-dedup, post-filter, post-NULL-planting, post-group-size-realization); pragma foreign_keys is ON during write and a post-write integrity check must report fk_violations = 0 and validity.invalid = 0. Group-size realization never overwrites a planted NULL with a non-NULL value; if it would, the NULL is re-planted afterward. construction_pairs_by_group must be populated with per-group eligible/separated counts so the reviewer can confirm boundary/near-variant/group-size targets are exercised.
